originality.rationale: The motivating 2026 paper already introduces W_r, the Bernoulli product law, and q^r leading eigenvalue hierarchy; the exact mean also follows classical renewal/Kac reasoning. The assessed addition is the explicit graph-dependent first relative spectral correction as the one-particle root Green resolvent, its Fibonacci path and star formulas, and the uniform fixed-graph exponential excursion limit. Direct scientific comparisons with primary accessible text, the predecessor, and targeted published-result queries found no stated or immediately numerical-table-identical theorem, with residual broader-coverage risk disclosed.
residual_risks: The general W_1 generator in the source implicitly determines the entire eigenvalue; an earlier asymptotic expansion could exist without recognizable title or abstract.

Publisher full text of the 2001 open-SEP correlation article and the complete 2023 two-reservoir stationary article were not inspected; evidence there is limited to abstracts.

value.rationale: The vacancy power alone predicts the same bottleneck across different branch morphologies. The new resolvent coefficient distinguishes a line branch from a hub-and-spoke branch at the first measurable finite-density correction, while explaining why their exact mean busy times coincide. This separation clarifies a topological trapping mechanism in the motivating high-density exclusion model; the coefficient is a natural Green-function invariant rather than an arbitrary graph statistic.
